basic_info.description: Wonderful 1BD/1BA at the Bridgeview Building in S. Beach. This well-appointed upper floor unit features: Sun-drenched living room/dining area with high ceilings. West facing urban outlook and peek-a-boo bay view. Private balcony off of living space. Natural maple colored hardwood flooring in the living area, woven carpet in the bedroom. Open kitchen with ample cabinets. Spacious bedroom with floor to ceiling window and custom walk-in wardrobe. Full bath with limestone tiling. Washer and dryer in-unit. One car deeded parking and storage locker. Bridgeview building amenities include: 24x7 security person, concierge, outdoor pool and spa, gym, roof terrace with BBQ area and on-site management. Ideally situated in the heart of south beach with easy access to Bay Bridge, Oracle Park, Fidi, Embarcadero, Farmer's Market, Ferry Plaza and East Cut Crossing Entertainment. Don't miss!
